faqs.question: What is PEAK?
faqs.answer: PEAK is an online-only e-commerce store founded in 2026, offering curated Men's, Women's, and Accessories collections built on material integrity, ethical production, and understated design.

faqs.question: When was PEAK founded?
faqs.answer: PEAK was founded in 2026.

faqs.question: What is PEAK's brand philosophy?
faqs.answer: PEAK was founded on the principle that true luxury is defined by material integrity, ethical production, and understated design rather than flashy logos. Every piece undergoes rigorous wear-testing, and we collaborate directly with family-owned mills and master artisans.

faqs.question: Do you have a physical store?
faqs.answer: PEAK is an online-only store. We don't currently have a physical retail location.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can reach us at info@peak.com or call +977 9803901467. We typically respond within 24-48 hours.

faqs.question: How long does support take to respond?
faqs.answer: Our support team typically responds within 24-48 hours.

faqs.question: Is shipping free?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer free standard worldwide shipping on all orders over $150.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Domestic orders within Nepal typically arrive within 3-5 business days. International orders typically take 7-14 business days.

faqs.question: What is the shipping cost for orders under $150?
faqs.answer: Orders under $150 have a flat shipping fee of $9.99 for domestic delivery within Nepal, or $19.99 for international orders.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes, PEAK ships worldwide, though a small number of regions may be restricted due to shipping limitations. Please note international orders may be subject to customs duties or import taxes.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day or weekend delivery?
faqs.answer: Same-day delivery is not currently offered. Weekend delivery availability has not been finalized — please contact support for the latest information.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, and other major cards via Stripe) and Cash on Delivery (COD).

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for domestic orders within Nepal. It is not currently available for international orders.

faqs.question: What currency are prices shown in?
faqs.answer: All prices on PEAK are listed in US Dollars (USD).

faqs.question: Is my payment information secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, all card payments are processed securely through Stripe. PEAK does not store your card details.

faqs.question: What should I do if my payment fails?
faqs.answer: Please try the payment again, or select Cash on Delivery if you're eligible (domestic orders only). If the issue continues, contact us at info@peak.com.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn and unused, with original tags still attached.

faqs.question: Are all items eligible for return, such as sale items?
faqs.answer: Final sale and clearance items are non-returnable and non-refundable. Other items can be returned within 30 days if unworn with original tags attached.

faqs.question: Who pays for return shipping?
faqs.answer: The customer is responsible for return shipping costs, unless the item arrived damaged or defective, in which case PEAK covers the return shipping.

faqs.question: How long does a refund take, and where is it sent?
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.

faqs.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
faqs.answer: Yes, exchanges for a different size or color are available within the 30-day return window, subject to stock availability.

faqs.question: What if my item arrives damaged or defective?
faqs.answer: Please contact us at info@peak.com. PEAK covers the return shipping and will prioritize a replacement or full refund for damaged or defective items.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Orders can be cancelled within 24 hours of placing them, or before the order has shipped, whichever comes first. Please contact info@peak.com as soon as possible. Cancellation cannot be guaranteed once an order has shipped.

faqs.question: Do you accept eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay, UPI, or mobile banking?
faqs.answer: No, PEAK does not accept eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay, UPI, or mobile banking. We only accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, and other major cards via Stripe) and Cash on Delivery (domestic orders within Nepal).

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: PEAK is an online-only store, so our website is open for shopping 24/7. Our customer support team is available 24/7 and typically responds to inquiries within 24-48 hours.

faqs.question: Can I return or get a refund if the tag has been removed or the item was worn?
faqs.answer: No. Items must be unworn and unused, with original tags still attached to be eligible for a return or refund. Items with tags removed cannot be returned or refunded.
